metadata.name: e21-channel-address-readback
metadata.description: Edit a disposable owner channel address, review sensitivity changes, verify exact readback after reload, and discard a later draft without external effects. Also edit the existing Web Push content-access scope by exact row, never render its endpoint, and confirm owner-scoped readback.
Owner-routed disposable Reach channel update and discard recovery, with no enrollment or delivery effect.

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const root=document.querySelector("[data-testid=reach-channel-editor]");const input=root?.querySelector("input[type=email]");const checked=[...(root?.querySelectorAll("input[type=checkbox]")||[])].filter(x=>x.checked).length;if(input?.value!=="owner@example.test"||checked!==4)throw new Error(`fixture channel mismatch value=${input?.value} labels=${checked}`);return {address:input.value,approvedLabels:checked,editByExistingRow:true}})()

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const root=document.querySelector("[data-testid=reach-channel-discard-review]");const text=root?.innerText||"";const header=document.querySelector("[data-selected-quiet-editor-header]");const buttons=[...(root?.querySelectorAll("button")||[])].map(button=>button.innerText.trim());const expected=["Public, Private","Draft adds Sensitive","Your draft adds Sensitive to the full-content labels for this device.","before returning to Devices"];if(expected.some(part=>!text.includes(part))||text.includes("Saved destination")||text.includes("Draft destination")||text.includes("Draft removes"))throw new Error(`discard review differs from the selected label-only state: ${text}`);if(!header?.innerText.includes("Content access")||!header.innerText.includes("E22 settings fixture device"))throw new Error("content-access device header is missing");if(!buttons.some(label=>label==="Keep editing")||!buttons.some(label=>label==="Discard changes"))throw new Error("discard actions are missing");return {savedApprovals:["Public","Private"],draftAdds:["Sensitive"],contextHeader:header.innerText,unchangedDestinationsHidden:true,visibleActions:buttons}})()

evaluate.expression: (()=>{document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement&&document.activeElement.blur();const root=document.documentElement;root.style.setProperty("--safe-area-inset-top","0px");root.style.setProperty("--safe-area-inset-bottom","0px");const theme=root.getAttribute("data-resolved-theme")||root.getAttribute("data-theme");const top=getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue("--safe-area-inset-top").trim(),bottom=getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue("--safe-area-inset-bottom").trim();if(innerWidth!==390||innerHeight!==844||theme!=="light"||top!=="0px"||bottom!=="0px")throw new Error(`Selected discard capture viewport mismatch ${innerWidth}x${innerHeight},${theme},${top},${bottom}`);return {viewport:{width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight},theme,top,bottom}})()

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const root=document.querySelector("[data-testid=reach-channel-editor]");const header=document.querySelector("[data-testid=reach-email-focused-header]");const text=root?.innerText||"";const headerText=header?.innerText||"";const checks=[...(root?.querySelectorAll("input[type=checkbox]")||[])];const checkedLabels=checks.filter(x=>x.checked).map(x=>x.closest("label")?.innerText.trim()).sort();const summary=root?.querySelector("[data-testid=reach-content-access-draft-diff]")?.innerText||"";const page=document.body.innerText||"";const expected=["Critical","Private","Public"];if(!root||!header||!headerText.includes("This browser · unchanged")||page.includes("fixture://web_push")||JSON.stringify(checkedLabels)!==JSON.stringify(expected)||!summary.includes("Saved: Public, Private, Critical"))throw new Error(`Web Push saved readback mismatch: header=${headerText}; editor=${text}; checked=${checkedLabels.join(",")}; summary=${summary}`);return {endpointRendered:false,destinationUnchanged:true,approvedLabels:["public","private","critical"],persistedAfterReload:true}})()
